design: Exploratory undirected classification-cycle inspection; three previously selected products with a same-code peer; three warmups and five randomized interleaved timed repetitions. Indexed file-backed generic SQLite node/edge model versus native Neo4j through HTTP. SQL plan control is a separate within-SQLite run.

redundant_classification_cycles.question: Which pairs of distinct linking records repeat a classification of this product?
redundant_classification_cycles.Cypher: MATCH (p:ProductRef {id:$product})<-[:ABOUT_PRODUCT]-(a:Association)-[:TARGET_ATC]->(c:ATCConcept)<-[:TARGET_ATC]-(b:Association)-[:ABOUT_PRODUCT]->(p) WHERE a.id<b.id RETURN a.id AS first,b.id AS second,c.id AS code
redundant_classification_cycles.SQL: SELECT wa.source_id first,wb.source_id second,c.source_id code FROM node p JOIN edge a ON a.t=p.id AND a.r='ABOUT_PRODUCT' JOIN edge b ON b.s=a.s AND b.r='TARGET_ATC' JOIN edge d ON d.t=b.t AND d.r='TARGET_ATC' JOIN edge e ON e.s=d.s AND e.r='ABOUT_PRODUCT' AND e.t=p.id JOIN node wa ON wa.id=a.s AND wa.label='Association' JOIN node c ON c.id=b.t AND c.label='ATCConcept' JOIN node wb ON wb.id=d.s AND wb.label='Association' WHERE p.label='ProductRef' AND p.source_id=:product AND wa.source_id<wb.source_id
redundant_classification_cycles.Browser: MATCH path=(p:ProductRef {id:$product})<-[:ABOUT_PRODUCT]-(a:Association)-[:TARGET_ATC]->(c:ATCConcept)<-[:TARGET_ATC]-(b:Association)-[:ABOUT_PRODUCT]->(p) WHERE a.id<b.id RETURN path

interpretation: Shortest classification paths explain recorded connectivity; they establish neither medicine equivalence nor reimbursement eligibility. Source-impact results identify dependent explanations, not changed judgments. Browser outputs demonstrate native visualization availability, not user comprehension or time saved. No schema/inference/visual superiority assumption.
